science.title: Meet REMORA: The autonomous space fleet built to tag and track asteroids
science.description: To truly understand what an asteroid is made of, we need to send a probe to it. Remote sensing from ground-based telescopes, or even orbiting observatories, can only do so much. A new white paper submitted to the U.K. Space Agency's 2035 Space Frontiers program (available on the arXiv preprint server) pitches just such a mission architecture. Called the REndezvous Mission for Orbital Reconstruction of Asteroids (REMORA), the plan calls for a swarm of autonomous CubeSats to tag, track and characterize multiple near-Earth asteroids.

science.title: NASA Study Challenges Theories on Where the Ingredients for Life Came From
science.description: NASA-supported scientists have provided new information about how the early Earth may have acquired some elements necessary for the planet to become habitable. They also suggest a new role for Jupiter in the distribution of these elements throughout the young solar system. The study, published in Science Advances, examines this history by looking at the ratio of phosphorus to nitrogen in iron meteorites and in younger objects known as chondrites.

ai.title: LG Electronics demonstrates evolution of AI Home ecosystem
ai.description: LG Electronics outlined its vision for an AI Home ecosystem designed to simplify everyday life through personalized and seamless experiences. The strategy is built on three core pillars: AI-powered appliances, ThinQ AI orchestration, and autonomous home robots, forming the foundation of the ThinQ AI Universe. The company detailed a three-phase evolutionary roadmap for the ThinQ platform, moving from reactive automation to a highly sophisticated, futuristic living environment. LG highlighted that innovations currently available in India, such as AI Wash 2.0 and ThinQ-enabled appliances, serve as building blocks toward this vision. The architectural peak of this ecosystem is LG CLOiD, a home-specialized autonomous AI agent unveiled at CES 2026. LG India is backing its software evolution with robust infrastructure, integrating its manufacturing plants in Greater Noida and Ranjangaon into the global AI roadmap to support the rollout of AI-centric products.
